text:
Sorry about the mix-up. Unfortunately, the 2-hour window for changing an order from "My Orders" has passed, so you can't change the address online. Your order is now in the packing queue, but support can try to intercept it before it ships. That isn't guaranteed, and once it ships the address can't be changed and couriers won't accept redirection requests from us.

If you send me your order number (LF- followed by six digits) and the correct address, I can pass it to support to try to intercept it right away.
